heard: The moon formed in hours, but part of its maker never left. Many believe the moon slowly formed from orbiting debris over millions of years. 4.5 billion years ago, a Mars-sized world named Theia smashed into our infant Earth. High-resolution simulations now show this collision could have formed the moon in just a few hours. But Theia did not just break apart. Our own planet swallowed the intruder whole. Massive iron-rich structures sit 1,800 miles deep beneath Africa and the Pacific Ocean. Two continent-sized blobs inside Earth are the ancient relics of Theia. Deep underground lies the heart of the intruder that never left.
